title: Devices: what this device has, and extensions that need more
steps: On a laptop, ⌘⇧P › Open user settings, then This device at the top: Width, Pointer, Touch and Keyboard, each with why. The keyboard is assumed, because it has a mouse or trackpad that hovers. Set Keyboard to No, then back to Auto.

Open this Preview with ?device=phone at the end of its address: the page is framed to a phone's 375 × 812 at the top left, with no keyboard found. Press Escape: "Keyboard found", and This device now says Yes, and keeps it after a reload. Leave with ?device= (empty).
Each browser has a device file: open .common-ink/users/<you>/devices/ from ⌘P and look at device.json and its history.
On a phone with a Bluetooth keyboard, tap into a note and press Escape: the app finds the keyboard the same way.
